NET DEBT / EBITDA — years of earnings needed to repay net debt.

SCALE (a boundary value always falls in the BETTER band):
• Negative/zero EBITDA → N/A (excluded from the score)
• ≤ 0 → 2 pts (Net Cash)
• ≤ 2 → 2 pts (Healthy)
• ≤ 4 → 1 pt (Moderate)
• above that → 0 pts (High leverage)

Net Cash and Healthy are both worth this row's full 2 points; the label still tells them apart. Turn on "Net Cash Required for Top Score" to restore the 0-3 scale.

2Y / NY columns show the raw ratio as reported for that fiscal year, not a change. A year with no data shows — and does not shift the other years.

• ≤ 10x → 2 pts (Cheap)
• ≤ 15x → 1 pt (Fair)
• above that → 0 pts (Expensive)

2Y / NY columns are the multiple AS OF that fiscal report — that year's EBITDA against the share price at the time — not today's price against old earnings.

REVENUE GROWTH — fiscal year over fiscal year, NOT year-to-date and not TTM.

Both endpoints are completed, reported fiscal years, so the figure only refreshes when the annual report publishes and follows the company's fiscal calendar, not the calendar year.

VALUE column: most recent Year-over-Year growth %.
2Y column: 2-year CAGR (annualized).
5Y column: CAGR over the lookback period (annualized).
N/A if fiscal-year history is insufficient, or if either endpoint is non-positive (CAGR is undefined across a sign flip).

VERDICT BASIS: 1Y (auto — longest available). The highlighted column is the figure being scored; the verdict label carries the same tag. Change it under Score & Growth.

SCALE (a boundary value always falls in the BETTER band):
• ≥ 15% → 🚀 High (2 pts)
• ≥ 5% → 📈 Steady (1 pt)
• ≥ 0% → 🟡 Slow (0 pts)
• < 0% → 🔻 Declining (0 pts)

Counts toward the score only if "Include Revenue Growth in Score" is enabled.
